technicalDecisions.decision: Use Azure Event Hubs instead of Kafka on VMs
technicalDecisions.rationale: Managed service reduces operational overhead. Kafka API compatibility allows easy migration. Azure integration for future phases.

technicalDecisions.decision: Use Langfuse for agent trace visualization
technicalDecisions.rationale: Open-source, GenAI-focused, beautiful UI. Alternative to LangSmith (vendor lock-in). OTLP support for flexibility.

technicalDecisions.decision: Separate topics for platform events and agent traces
technicalDecisions.rationale: Different schemas, retention policies, and consumers. Easier to evolve independently. Clear separation of concerns.
One user can have multiple sessions. Session = atomic unit of interaction. Better granularity for analysis.
Don't block API responses on event delivery. Eventual consistency acceptable for analytics. Retry logic handles transient failures.
Type safety, automatic documentation, validation at write time. Prevents bad data in Event Hubs.

risks.risk: Event Hubs connection failures cause event loss
risks.mitigation: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff. Log failures to local file as fallback. Monitor Event Hubs health.

risks.risk: High event volume exceeds Event Hubs throughput
risks.mitigation: Start with Standard tier (1 MB/s ingress). Scale up if needed. Batch events to reduce overhead. Monitor throughput metrics.
End-to-end integration tests validate propagation. Logging at each hop. Documentation with examples.
Use sampling for high-volume production. Benchmark with/without OTel. Optimize span creation.
Monitor usage daily. Implement sampling in production. Budget for paid tier if needed.
